programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. The witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall, gets truly dunked and goes horribly wrong, when the water starts turning red. Barnaby and Jones have to be alert with a shooter in their midst. With many grudges, jealousies and a dispute over wasteland, known as 'the swamp', as possible motives, it is not long before more people turn up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road. Shortly after a body is found in the local old cemetery. The victim Gerald Ebbs was a member of the council and of the village's library. It is discovered from the villagers that Gerald had had a strange fixation on both the old hospital and cemetery; in particular a grave from within.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician Sir Michael Fielding, is a magnet for many aspiring piano students. Amongst the latest batch of students is Zoe Stock, a gifted young lady. Whilst in the grounds of the manor and by the riverbank, Zoe sees a woman jump from the bridge and disappear underwater. When Barnaby and Jones start their enquiries into the possible drowning, they discover many shady connections to the past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When boxer John Kinsella wins a world title in New York, the village of Midsomer Morchard are overjoyed at his success. Shortly afterwards a solicitor is found dead by his assistant and Kinsella's manager. Barnaby and Jones start to investigate and come across infidelity, anger, betrayals and blackmail. When a Victorian prize-fight re-enactment turns nasty and Kinsella's manager is found murdered in his home's gym.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Conservation Society are up in arms, when a recent new build, called Swanscombe House is a highlight of an open garden day. It leads to an ugly confrontation between a couple of its members and those responsible for the planning application, design and build. The people of which are suspected of involvement in a money-making scam. Political squabbles, burglaries and sexual liaisons all come to the fore in picturesque Great Pelfe.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A spa weekend at Swavely Manor, proves far from relaxing, when Tom and Joyce Barnaby arrive. It starts stressful and goes rather downhill when a female client is found dead in the flotation chamber, by Joyce. Barnaby takes a break from his treatment to investigate alongside Jones. The mystery deepens when the woman's husband disappears in the night shortly afterwards. Tom's worries about his future seem to distract him from the case.

programme.desc: The peace of Ferne Basset is shattered when the body of quiet animal lover Agnes Gray is bludgeoned to death and found floating in the nearby river. programme.desc: Bill Carter, one of the founders of a New Age commune called the 'Lodge of the Golden Windhorse', dies after falling down the stairs and breaking his neck. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young man is found murdered during its grand reopening, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch the killer.

programme.desc: The Bleakridge Watch patrols the streets of their remote village, exposing anyone who steps outside the law.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover a dead body covered in live rabbits, it reveals a sinister side to the local pet show. Is this a rivalry taken too far or is the killer driven by something darker?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young girl slips away from a Jane Austen weekend dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter need to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter's investigations lead them deep into a world haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Malham Bridge, eccentric widow Isobel Hewitt and adulterous doctor Duncan Goff are both murdered while fly fishing near the riverbank. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy question if one or the other was the target and whether one just happened to stumble across the other. Many suspects and motives abound, as the detectives try to find out. When another murder takes place, Barnaby deduces that it may have been a distraction to conceal the killer's identity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of Martin Wroath is found in his home in Midsomer Worthy. From first appearances it looks as though he had committed suicide by shotgun. Evidence soon suggests that he was murdered. When a second murder takes place on the grounds of the cottage hospital, the detectives need to uncover any possible connections to link the deaths, as well as the mysteriously disappearing rope.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Joyce joins the local watercolour society for an open-air art class, upon the village green in Midsomer Florey. Shortly before taking a break, she stumbles across the body of elderly Ruth Fairfax, a fellow artist found in the undergrowth. It turns out that she had more to her than meets the eye. When Barnaby is taken off the case by the NIS, it is left to Troy to 'apprehensively' let Barnaby in on what's going on with the investigation.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: At the family home of actor Larry Smith in the village of Upper Warden, a crowd has gathered to watch the promotion for the sequel to his hit film 'The House of Satan', when Larry walks into a summerhouse house in the grounds, it suddenly explodes. His family quickly suggest that it was someone from the rival village of Lower Warden. When Larry's director; another member of his family is also murdered, electrocuted while using an exercise bike.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Magna, the body of a man is found who had apparently drowned himself. It is discovered later that he was desperately seeking a way out of bankruptcy after visiting a local millionaire to get back his money from a scheme he had invested in. The post-mortem says that he was indeed murdered. Whilst DS Troy assists a pretty wildlife liaison officer with an investigation into the illegal sale of protected birds eggs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life….including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Micah Torrance, formerly a famous marshal, who is now a drunk crippled from a gunfight, stumbles into North Fork. Lucas McCain hires him in hopes of rehabilitating the man. The good deed quickly backfires when outlaws arrive.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark's uncle, Johnny Gibb, a famous rodeo rider, comes to visit. Mark idolizes his uncle, but Lucas soon discovers that Johnny is on the run from the law after robbing an express office, and is afraid that Johnny is a bad influence on young Mark.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: A cattle baron awaits the return of his daughter from school and is surprised that his wife has returned to take their daughter away. He tries to keep the peace and do what is best for everyone.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A land speculator named Willard Prescott contacts Lucas about buying his land as the railroad is fast approaching the area. He bribes Lucas and when he refuses, Prescott makes it clear he will stop at nothing to get his land, one way or the other.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Newly deputized, Cheyenne brings law and order to a small town after the murder of its sheriff. Once there, he uses an old stage trick from the play "Hamlet" to bring a corrupt businessman to justice for murder.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Beau Maverick is framed for the murder of his casino business partner. To clear his name, Beau tracks down Flo, a saloon singer who changed her identity to work as a teacher. Meanwhile, the dead man's brother and a sheriff are hot on Beau's trail.

programme.desc: Five cowboys are left, and host Trace Adkins and his judges test the cowboys on their solo cattle-sorting skills and evaluate their abilities to work as a team extracting buffalo from a herd. In the end, another cowboy is sent home.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Corrupt Judge Burton seeks justice against those who are responsible for the hanging of his son, including Lucas McCain, who caught him. When Burton discovers that Lucas has a son, he captures Lucas to make him watch Mark suffer the same punishment.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Italian Count Alfredo Di Montova comes to North Fork. His unique clothing attracts the attention of town bully Sim Groder. When Groder pushes the count too far, Montova initiates a duel, and asks Lucas to assist with the rules.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: Two renegade Indians known as the Loco Brothers kidnap Captain Wilton Parmenter from Fort Courage and hold him captive in a cave. It seems all they want is someone to talk to and be friends with. Later, the renegades join the friendly Hekawi Tribe.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: A beautiful, young Japanese woman named Miko seeks refuge at Fort Courage, escaping from an arranged marriage. A samurai pursues her to bring her back to Japan. The F Troop faces the samurai's wrath as he will stop at nothing in his pursuit.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: For months, a thin wall of rock is all that keeps the peace between two rival silver mining companies 300 feet below the Idaho desert. When the barrier is finally breached, pickaxes give way to pistols and rifles, and the miners battle for five days.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After the suspicious death of a tunnel worker, and unconvincing answers from the project's lead engineer, Doc Susie goes on a covert mission to find out what happened. Deep underground, she finds her own life in peril when she's trapped by a cave-in.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: As a member of Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery, John Colter travels from the Missouri River all the way to the Pacific Ocean, but he decides not to return to the civilized East when the expedition ends. Entranced by the beauty and adventure of the wild frontier, he becomes one of America's first mountain men. As a hunter, trapper and explorer in his own right, he's the first American to see the Grand Tetons and the epic Yellowstone Valley. While his epic explorations make him famous, it's a harrowing ordeal with Blackfeet warriors that makes him a legend. After boldly venturing into territory controlled by the Blackfeet tribe, Colter is captured, stripped naked, and forced to run for his life as warriors give chase in what will come to be known as Colter's Run.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: Frontiersman Jim Bridger spins an incredible tale to a group of settlers, claiming he was once killed by Blackfeet warriors yet somehow lived to tell the tale. They think he's joking, but Bridger soon proves that he really did rise from the dead.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: When they are ambushed by a Blackfeet war party, Jim Bridger and a lone Shoshone brave must work together to find a way to defeat their common enemy. If they can't overcome their suspicions and learn to trust each other, they may not survive the day.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bart Maverick travels to Hound Dog, Tennessee to collect a gambling debt but gets involved with a mysterious woman claiming to be a witch and her burly brothers. He soon finds himself in the middle of light-hearted, bizarre trouble in the mountains.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Cheyenne scouts for Army troops one last time to deliver supplies to Fort Burnside with both inexperienced Captain Duquesne and Trooper Daily. The captain dismisses Cheyenne's concerns over the Shoshone, who later attack them.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: When a member of a powerful gang of outlaws murders a local shopkeeper, the killer is sentenced to be hanged. The leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage in an attempt to gain the killer's freedom.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas serves as a jury foreman when a Mescalero Apache Indian is found guilty of murder and is hanged. A Mescalero medicine man places a curse on Lucas. At first Lucas brushes it off, then unusual events begin to happen including a ghost stallion.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A brutal snowstorm makes the roads impassable and forces a stagecoach to stop at the McCain Ranch. Lucas gives the passengers shelter, but little does he know a dance hall girl, a drunk, and a famous gunslinger are his guests.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Brothers Charv and Kelly Banner play a joke on Lucas that soon gets out of hand when they contact a St. Louis marriage bureau to send a possible bride for Lucas. Mary Woodson arrives in North Fork ready for marriage, but Lucas wants no part of it.

programme.desc: Suspected of murder, Richard Bone (Jeff Bridges) turns to his best friend, Alex Cutter (John Heard), for help finding the real killer. But when their suspect turns the tables on them, a cunning game of cat-and-mouse ignites into a full-blown war!

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: 10 To Midnight
programme.desc: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

programme.title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
programme.desc: Action superstar Charles Bronson is at his two-fisted best in this gritty thriller about a hardnosed vice cop who is hellbent on wiping out a child prostitution ring after an assault on his young daughter; taking vengeance into his own hands!

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threatens to kill hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Cherry 2000
programme.desc: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Rollerball (2002)
programme.desc: Chris Klein, LL Cool J, and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos star in this high-octane thriller as the hottest team in the brutal sport Rollerball. When they discover the league's owner (Jean Reno) will do anything for ratings, they plan to take down the sport!

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Set against the wondrous backdrop of the Great Pyramids, "Stargate" tells the story of two very different men (Kurt Russell, James Spader) who join forces to unravel the mystery of a curious artifact which could reveal the origin of civilization.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Scorpio
programme.desc: Two spies thrust together by political forces beyond their control find themselves fighting for their live amidst the brutality of the Cold War!

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Tigerland
programme.desc: A group of recruits go through Advanced Infantry Training at Fort Polk, Louisiana's infamous Tigerland, last stop before Vietnam for tens of thousands of young men in 1971.

programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by his grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey to find a place to call home.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Yul Brynner stars as one of seven gunslingers pitted against an army of marauding bandits in this rousing classic that made stars of Steve McQueen, Charles Bronson and James Coburn. Eli Wallach also stars in this timeless tale of good versus evil.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

programme.title: Gun The Man Down
programme.desc: When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

programme.title: Gun Duel In Durango
programme.desc: When an outlaw tries to live an honest life, his revengeful old cohorts frame him for a crime. Now he must prove his innocence...before it’s too late!

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City
programme.desc: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

programme.title: The Return Of A Man Called Horse
programme.desc: Richard Harris stars in this exceptional western as Lord John Morgan, who returns to his adoptive family only to find the entire Sioux tribe in peril.

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: Man Of The East
programme.desc: East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse
programme.desc: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.
